newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares end steady as profittaking ebbs.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares end steady as profittaking ebbs.

text.p: Slovenian shares stabilised on Friday as profit-taking ahead of a new securities tax ran out of steam, traders said.
"Unless some major move or information appears, the market will remain stable until the end of the year," Andrej Ciuha, a trader of brokerage Inter Timex said.
* The 10-share SBI index rose 1.40 points to 1,162.9.
* Bank SKB was the most active trading share, firming 0.25 percent to an average 41,857 tolars on volume of 567 shares.
* Overall eight shares rose, nine fell and eight were untraded. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
